series.name: Accio marketplace FAQ (E1/E6/EC)
series.notes: Accio Super General AC Error Code List 2026 — marketplace FAQ (3 codes). Secondary; overlaps AirChill on E1/E6/EC.

meaning.en: Signals between indoor and outdoor units are lost — caused by bad wiring, mis-wiring, or a defective control board.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke darmiyan signal gum ho jate hain — is ki wajah kharab wiring, galat connection, ya kharab control board hai.

causes.en: Faulty or incorrectly connected inter-unit wiring
causes.ur: Dono unit ke darmiyan wali wiring kharab ya galat tareeqe se connected

causes.en: Defective control board on either unit
causes.ur: Dono mein se kisi ek unit ka control board kharab ho jana

solutions.en: Inspect and re-terminate the communication cable
solutions.ur: Pehle communication cable ko theek tarah check karein aur loose terminals dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the faulty PCB after technician testing
solutions.ur: Technician ki testing ke baad kharab PCB ko badal dein

source.title: Accio — Super General AC Error Code List 2026

notes.en: Duplicate code string also in §5.1; kept per-source. Accio pages frequently paraphrase AirChill for other brands — treat as medium, not fully independent.
notes.ur: Yeh code string §5.1 mein bhi mojood hai; source ke mutabiq rakha gaya hai. Accio pages aksar doosri brands ke liye AirChill ka hi mutarjam banate hain — ise medium maan lein, puri tarah mustaqil nahi.

meaning.en: Loss of synchronized communication between indoor and outdoor units, cutting cooling/heating performance.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units ke darmiyan sync communication chali jati hai, jis se cooling/heating ka kaam kam ho jata hai.

causes.ur: Wiring toot gayi ya connectors dheele hue

causes.en: PCB fault on indoor or outdoor side
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor side ka PCB kharab

solutions.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan wali cable shuru se le kar end tak check karein

solutions.en: Technician replaces the defective board if wiring is fine
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to technician kharab board ko badal deta hai

source.title: Accio — Super General AC Error Code List 2026

notes.en: Matches AirChill E6 and Voltiat E6 → high.
notes.ur: AirChill E6 aur Voltiat E6 se milta hai → confidence high.

meaning.en: Leak sensor logic tripped: low refrigerant charge or an actual leak in the copper circuit.
meaning.ur: Leak sensor ka logic trigger hua: refrigerant ki charge kam hai ya copper circuit mein asal leak hai.

causes.en: Low gas pressure from a slow leak
causes.ur: Dheere dheere leak ki wajah se gas ka pressure kam ho jana

solutions.en: Stop the unit and arrange leak repair
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur leak theek karwane ka intezam karein

solutions.en: Recharge gas only after the leak is fixed
solutions.ur: Gas sirf leak theek hone ke baad bharein

source.title: Accio — Super General AC Error Code List 2026

notes.ur: AirChill aur Voltiat se is par ittefaq hai.
